note: One file for the MSTX tab, the gap monitor and the TradingView indicator. Holdings and ADSO come live from api.strategy.com. btc_slope_per_2500 0.025 is Alex's sheet and matches the last three months' measured mNAV beta (0.81); it sets the projected price and therefore Cheap and Rich. lag_slope 0.0125 is DELIBERATELY different: the lag is a minute-scale deviation from its own trailing average, a different job from pricing a level, and it separates better at the lower slope. On 60 days of 5-minute bars at the bar low, distinct events 60+ minutes apart, 0.0125 at a -3.0% MSTX line gave 17 events (2.0/week), 65% positive at 60 minutes, median MSTX +0.49% and median MSTR-minus-BTC +0.28% -- the best hit rate of any slope and threshold pair tested. 0.025 at -3.0% was 13 events and 62% positive with a negative median on the market-neutral measure. Alex's call, 9/17. On 19 days of 1-minute bars the three slopes are statistically indistinguishable (10 to 15 events), so the 5-minute window is what this rests on. lag_threshold -0.015 = -3.0% MSTX, measured at MSTR's bar low (lag_at_low). lag_watch -0.01 = -2.0% MSTX, logged to the ledger without a push so the shallow zone keeps accumulating evidence. cheap_threshold -0.03 and rich_threshold 0.04 are MSTR terms; the Cheap and Rich tests run on the MSTX gap at twice these. regime_gate true governs LAG and CHEAP only, which is the rule Alex actually stated: use the buy signals when BTC is above its 50-day. rich_gate false since 9/17: Rich fires in either regime. The mirror-image rule that Rich should fire only below the 50-day was a symmetry assumption the system added, never Alex's, and it is the least supported rule in the file. Rich declined in BOTH states on the daily data at a +3% MSTR line: MSTR minus BTC over ten days -8.25% with BTC above its 50-day, -5.41% median below, five of six below-gate episodes down against BTC. The mechanism is why this is more than a six-episode backtest: Rich measures the premium to net asset value, which is the condition that mechanically triggers MSTR's at-the-market issuance, so a rich reading identifies new supply arriving rather than merely correlating with a decline. Caveat on all gate evidence: the STRC era is a downtrend end to end, so every above-the-50-day day in the sample is a bounce inside a decline and the gate has never been observed in a real uptrend. Review 2026-09-20 measured a -4.24% bare rule nowcast bias in chk_models_review.md, so gap_centre 0.04 centres Cheap and Rich on the rounded 4% MSTR premium and setting it to 0 reverts.
